caption: The base of a steep pile of dry sand in a sandbox is scraped away, and a section of the slope above slides down as a sheet and comes to rest at a gentler angle.

sa.check: A steep pile of dry sand is in a sandbox.
A section of the slope above slides down as a sheet.
It comes to rest at a gentler angle.
The scrape comes first and the slide follows.

pc.expect: The slide starts where the support was removed.
pc.fail: It starts before the scrape; or elsewhere; or the base is scraped and nothing moves.

pc.expect: It moves downhill with the grains flowing, and the pile ends flatter than it began.
pc.fail: It steepens; or rebuilds itself; or slides uphill.

pc.expect: It flows as grains, not as a block.
pc.fail: It moves as a block; or flows like liquid; or bounces.
It keeps flowing indefinitely; or reverses; or jumps.

pc.expect: One pile keeps its total of sand.
pc.fail: Sand appears from nowhere; or vanishes; or the pile duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The sand's colour and the sandbox stay the same.
pc.fail: The sand changes colour; or the box changes; or the background rearranges.
